title: Using Shared Data and Utility Methods
instructions: Create a `DatabaseConnector` class to use both a class variable for a constant setting and a static method for data cleaning.
steps: Define a **class attribute** called `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT` and set its value to `10` (seconds).
Implement a **static method** `sanitize_input(text)` that takes a string `text` and returns a lowercase version of the text with leading/trailing whitespace removed.
Print the value of `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT` directly from the class.
Call the static method `sanitize_input` on the class with the input `'    Hello World!   '`. Print the result.
starterCode:
class DatabaseConnector:
    # 1. Define the class attribute here
    

    # 2. Implement the static method here


# 3. Print the class attribute
print(DatabaseConnector.DEFAULT_TIMEOUT)

# 4. Call and print the static method
print(DatabaseConnector.sanitize_input('    Hello World!   '))
hints: The class attribute should be defined without `self` or `def`.
The static method must be decorated with `@staticmethod` and accept only the `text` parameter (no `self` or `cls`).
Use the `.strip()` and `.lower()` string methods to clean the input.
